name: @seris/desktop
description: Seris desktop shell (Tauri). Thin packaging layer: spawns and supervises the @seris/core gateway; the WebView talks straight to the gateway over same-origin HTTP+SSE.

scripts.dev: pnpm --dir ../core build && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.build:app: pnpm --dir ../core build && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs && tauri build
